summary: Created the complete B1 Proposal, Design, flowkit-core-model capability delta, and Tasks from the approved Explore. The proposal preserves mandatory Review boundaries, treats Revision/Fix as conditional and repeatable, allows the owner to perform the reviewer role without bypassing Verdict, and explicitly replaces revise-apply with fix-review-findings.

findingsAddressed.NB-001: Defined fullTestStatus as Flowkit-owned Delivery verification substate; Bootstrap uses Delivery YAML as a manual projection, self-hosting uses Delivery state, and Delivery Runs are not authoritative.
findingsAddressed.NB-002: Defined owner-authorized cancellation for planned/active Changes and active Deliveries while preserving artifacts, Runs, Git history, and dependency blocking.
findingsAddressed.NB-003: The formal contract uses abstract review-method categories and does not bind any concrete Skill identifier.

additionalDecisions: Review remains a required lifecycle boundary even when the owner performs the reviewer role.
Revision/Fix is applicable only after changes-requested and may repeat with Review until approved or cancelled.
Owner cannot bypass a changes-requested Verdict.
fix-review-findings explicitly supersedes the Bootstrap v1 term revise-apply.

verification.reason: This commit creates proposal artifacts only. OpenSpec strict validation and document verification belong to the subsequent Apply preparation and Change verification tasks.
